No platforms. No subscriptions. Just infrastructure you own.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a complete digital commerce stack designed to operate independently of third-party platforms. For Filipino creators, this means no more reliance on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad. Instead, you deploy your own store using free tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and Supabase for order storage. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. This architecture ensures you own every component—from hosting to payment processing—and are not subject to geographic restrictions or platform shutdowns. It’s built to withstand the financial isolation many creators face, giving you control over your revenue streams.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The system is modular and decentralized. Your storefront is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, both free and globally distributed via Cloudflare’s CDN. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which process orders and trigger payment verification. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, depending on your stack. File delivery is managed via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring instant access for buyers. NOWPayments acts as the payment gateway, verifying crypto transactions on-chain and firing a webhook to deliver products automatically. The entire stack is designed to be lightweight, cost-effective, and fully automated. You deploy it once, and it runs without ongoing fees or platform dependencies.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are inaccessible or unreliable. If you’re in the Philippines, Ghana, Kenya, or similar markets, and you sell digital products like ebooks, courses, or templates, this system is for you. It’s also for creators who value ownership over convenience. With COREMERCH, you don’t rent infrastructure—you own it. There are no subscriptions, no platform fees, and no risk of being locked out. It’s pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are realities. If you’re tired of being blocked by geographic restrictions, this is your solution.
Own your infrastructure—no platforms, no subscriptions, no geographic barriers.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component in the stack serves a specific purpose. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide fast, free hosting with global reach. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend tasks like order processing and payment verification. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely and efficiently. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver files instantly after payment. NOWPayments integrates seamlessly, supporting low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates for these components, allowing you to deploy a fully functional store in 48 hours. Every piece is chosen for its reliability, cost-effectiveness, and ease of use, ensuring you can focus on creating, not troubleshooting.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing the stack that fits your needs. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is ideal for beginners, while the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. If you prefer to build yourself, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates. Once you’ve selected your stack, follow the deployment guide to set up hosting, backend logic, and payment processing. Load your products, test the system end-to-end, and go live. The entire process is designed to be straightforward, even if you’re not a developer. With 30-day support included, you’ll have help every step of the way. Deploy today and take control of your digital commerce infrastructure.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Filipino digital creators can accept payments using NOWPayments, a crypto payment gateway that supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. It requires no KYC, no buyer accounts, and automatically verifies transactions on-chain. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep fees under $0.10 per transaction. This solution bypasses geographic restrictions and gives creators full control over their payment processing, eliminating reliance on platforms like Stripe or PayPal.
Deploy in 48 hours with pre-built stacks or customize with the Complete Builder Kit.

If you’re ready to deploy sovereign commerce infrastructure, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates needed to build your own digital store. It’s designed for creators in regions like the Philippines, where traditional payment platforms are unavailable. With this kit, you’ll own every component of your stack, from hosting to payment processing, ensuring you’re never locked out again.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for quick deployment, or Complete Builder Kit ($197) for full customization. 2. Set up hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 3. Configure backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 4. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. 5. Store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets. 6. Set up file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 7. Test the system end-to-end to ensure seamless operation. 8. Launch your store and start accepting payments.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The stacks are designed for non-developers, with clear documentation and 30-day support included. You don’t need coding skills to deploy or manage your store.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins like USDT. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON.
Do I need to pay ongoing fees?
No. The infrastructure uses free tools like GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Workers. The only fee is NOWPayments’ 0.5% transaction charge.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments operates on a decentralized blockchain network, making downtime extremely rare. Even if it does, your store remains functional, and payments can be processed once it’s back online.
Can I scale this system as my business grows?
Yes. The architecture is designed to scale. The Complete Builder Kit includes a scaling playbook to help you handle increased traffic and transactions.
